Item.Name: S_EQUIPMENT_TYPE
Item.Hint: Scan the equipment bar code, or enter 'M' for manual entry.

Trigger.Name: KEY-NEXT-ITEM
Trigger.TriggerText:
declare
 temp_start_code varchar2(3) := '+';
 temp_end_code varchar2(3) := '+';
 temp_len number;
begin
 nullchk;
 check_package_failure;
 temp_len := length(temp_start_code);
 if :s_equipment_type = 'M' then
 CLEAR_ITEM;
 NEXT_ITEM;
 else
 if length(:s_equipment_type) != 6 + length(temp_start_code) + length(temp_end_code) then
 :s_equipment_type := null;
 show_error ('1210'); --invalid scan length
 check_package_failure;
 end if;
 if nvl(substr(:s_equipment_type, 1, temp_len),'nullx') != nvl(temp_start_code,'nullx') or
 nvl(substr(:s_equipment_type, 7 + temp_len, length(temp_start_code)),'nullx') !=
 nvl(temp_end_code,'nullx') then
 :s_equipment_type := null;
 show_error ('6076'); --invalid start/end code
 check_package_failure;
 end if;
--
-- check and see if a valid equipment reference number
--
 begin
 select 'x' into :GLOBAL.x from equipment e
 where e.equip_reference = 'EQ-'||substr(:s_equipment_type, temp_len + 1, 6);
 exception
 when no_data_found then
 show_error ('1325');
 check_package_failure;
 end;
--
-- check and see if authorized to make edits for equipment of this type
--
 begin
 select 'X' into :global.x
 from fcn_grp_priv f, equip_access_privs ea, equipment e
 where f.appl_id = 'DON'
 and f.user_id = upper(:banner.user_id)
 and ea.fcn_grp = f.grp_id
 and ea.equip_type = e.equip_type
 and e.equip_reference= 'EQ-'||substr(:s_equipment_type, temp_len + 1, 6)
 and sysdate between ea.eff_date and nvl(ea.term_date, sysdate+1);
 exception
 when no_data_found then
 show_error ('1302');
 check_package_failure;
 end;
--
-- set all ctrl blk values.
--
 begin
 select e.equip_type, substr(m.code_desc,1,13), e.equip_id, e.equip_reference
 into :CTRL_BLK_1.equipment_type, :CTRL_BLK_1.s_equip_desc, :CTRL_BLK_1.equipment_id,
 :CTRL_BLK_1.equipment_reference
 from equipment e, equip_master_codes m
 where e.equip_reference = 'EQ-'||substr(:s_equipment_type, temp_len + 1, 6)
 and m.code = e.equip_type
 and m.code_type = 'EQUIP';
 exception
 when others then
 handle_error;
 check_package_failure;
 end;
 GO_ITEM ('EQUIPMENT_REFERENCE');
 execute_trigger ('KEY-NEXT-ITEM');
 end if;
end;

Item.Name: QUALIFICATION_DATE
Item.Hint: Enter date that this machine was qualified, [MM-DD-YY] format.
Item.Label: Qualification Date

Trigger.Name: VALIDATE_FIELD
Trigger.TriggerText:
declare
v_local_time date;
v_local_date date;

begin
--
-- Invalid date is trapped by on_error. On_error routine will Popup an error screen, if you try
-- to display another error using show_error. On_error is invoked the first time that the contents 
-- of the date field is referenced, so this section of code just checks for date format errors using the
-- on_error checks.
--
 begin
 :GLOBAL.date := to_char(:equipment_qualification.qualification_date, 'MM-DD-YY');
 exception
 when others then
 raise form_trigger_failure;
 end;
--
 if (:equipment_qualification.qualification_date is null) then
 show_error ('1307');
 check_package_failure;
 end if;
 
 if is_timezone_enabled then
 Lifetrack_timezone_convert.get_local_time(:global.chapter_id,sysdate,v_local_time);
 v_local_date := v_local_time;
 else
 v_local_date := sysdate;
 end if;
 
 if (:equipment_qualification.qualification_date > trunc(v_local_date)) then
 show_error ('8030');
 check_package_failure;
 end if;
--
-- validate that qualification date is after all required QC dates.
--
 :GLOBAL.x := null;
 begin
 select 'X' into :GLOBAL.x 
 from equip_qc_ctrl_hdr ctrl
 where ctrl.equip_type = :CTRL_BLK_1.equipment_type
 and ctrl.required_flag = 'Y'
 and not exists
 (select 'x' from equip_qc_hdr qc
 where qc.equip_reference = :CTRL_BLK_1.equipment_reference
 and qc.qc_type = ctrl.qc_type
 and qc.qc_status = 'A'
 --and trunc(qc.qc_date) <= trunc(:equipment_qualification.qualification_date)); -- Commented by Kishore on 04/27/2012. IM 8518
 and trunc(lifetrack_timezone_convert.get_local_time(:global.chapter_id, qc.qc_date)) <= 
 trunc(:equipment_qualification.qualification_date)); -- Added by Kishore on 04/27/2012. IM 8518
 exception
 when no_data_found then
 :GLOBAL.x := null;
 when too_many_rows then
 :GLOBAL.x := 'X';
 when others then
 handle_error;
 check_package_failure;
 end;
 if (:GLOBAL.x is not null) then
 show_error ('1329');
 check_package_failure;
 end if;
end;

Trigger.Name: KEY-COMMIT
Trigger.TriggerText:
begin
 execute_trigger ('validate_field');
 check_package_failure;
 execute_trigger ('validate_qualification');
 check_package_failure;
 
 
 if (:SYSTEM.block_status = 'CHANGED') then
 
 
 
 :EQUIPMENT_QUALIFICATION.last_modified_date := sysdate;
 
 
 :EQUIPMENT_QUALIFICATION.modified_by := :BANNER.user_id;
 :EQUIPMENT_QUALIFICATION.program_id := 'EQIQUALF';
--
-- Update equipment to reflect the first production date.
--
 if (:equipment_qualification.first_production_date is not null) then
 begin
 update equipment e
 set e.first_production_date = :equipment_qualification.first_production_date,
 e.qualification_flag = decode (nvl(:equipment_qualification.qualified_by, 'NOT DONE'),
 'NOT DONE', null, 'Y')
 where e.equip_reference = :ctrl_blk_1.equipment_reference
 and nvl(e.first_production_date, sysdate-3650) != :equipment_qualification.first_production_date;
 exception 
 when no_data_found then
 null;
 when others then
 handle_error;
 check_package_failure;
 end;
 
 end if;
 
 :SYSTEM.message_level := 20;
 commit;
 :SYSTEM.message_level := 0;
 show_error ('0000');
 
 
 else
 show_error ('8013');
 end if;
 
 
 execute_query; -- jairam wrote for IM 5203. 
end;

ProgramUnit.Name: POP_QC_SCHEDULE_1
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
PROCEDURE pop_qc_schedule_1 IS
 cursor bad_qcs is
 select qc.qc_type a1, qc.qc_reference a2, to_char(qc.qc_date, 'MM-DD-YY') a3, qc.qc_tech_1 a4,
 substr(mc.code_desc,1,42) a5
 from equip_qc_hdr qc, equip_master_codes mc
 where qc.equip_reference = :ctrl_blk_1.equipment_reference
 and (qc_result_1 not in ('A', 'S', 'C') or qc_status not in ('A', 'S', 'C'))
 and not exists
 (select 'x' from equip_qc_hdr qc2
 where qc2.equip_reference = qc.equip_reference 
 and qc2.qc_type = qc.qc_type
 and qc2.qc_result_1 = 'A'
 and qc2.qc_status = 'A'
 and qc2.qc_date > qc.qc_date)
 and mc.code_type = 'QCSTS'
 and mc.code = qc.qc_status
union
 select qc.qc_type a1, '' a2, '' a3, '' a4, 'Required QC has not been performed' a5
 from equip_qc_ctrl_hdr qc
 where qc.equip_type = :ctrl_blk_1.equipment_type
 and qc.required_flag = 'Y'
 and sysdate between qc.eff_date and nvl(qc.term_date, sysdate+1)
 and not exists 
 (select 'x' from equip_qc_hdr qc2
 where qc2.equip_reference = :ctrl_blk_1.equipment_reference
 and qc2.qc_type = qc.qc_type)
 order by 1, 3; 
BEGIN
 go_record ('1');
--
 for c1 in bad_qcs loop
 :qc_schedule.dummy1 := null;
 :qc_schedule.qc_type_desc := c1.a1;
 :qc_schedule.s_qc_ref_no := c1.a2;
 :qc_schedule.qc_date := c1.a3;
 :qc_schedule.performed_by := c1.a4;
 :qc_schedule.status_desc := c1.a5;
 down;
 end loop;
 go_record ('1');
 if (:qc_schedule.qc_type_desc is null) then
 :qc_schedule.dummy1 := null;
 :qc_schedule.qc_type_desc := 'OK';
 :qc_schedule.s_qc_ref_no := null;
 :qc_schedule.qc_date := null;
 :qc_schedule.performed_by := null;
 :qc_schedule.status_desc := 'Machine has all required QCs completed.';
 end if;
 END;
